import { Card, CardGrid, LinkCard } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

beamhop is one process on one port, but it speaks several protocols. That makes it a good base for a lot of
different projects: a Nostr client that just needs a relay, a media app that needs somewhere to put files, a
community with its own rules, or an ops script that manages users from a cron job.

This section is for people who want to talk to beamhop from code, or change what it does from the inside.

## The surfaces

Everything is served from the same origin. With a relay at `https://relay.example.com`:

```
wss://relay.example.com/            → Nostr relay (NIP-01 and friends)
https://relay.example.com/          → NIP-11 (Accept: application/nostr+json), NIP-86 management RPC
https://relay.example.com/<sha256>  → Blossom blobs (BUD-01/02/04/06/08/11/12)
https://relay.example.com/admin/    → admin panel (PWA)
https://relay.example.com/admin/api → admin REST API
https://relay.example.com/plugins/… → plugin public routes
https://relay.example.com/metrics   → Prometheus metrics
https://relay.example.com/health    → readiness probe
```

<CardGrid>
  <Card title="Nostr clients" icon="rocket">
    Any NIP-01 client works. beamhop adds search, COUNT, negentropy sync, groups, auth and more.
    See the [NIP support matrix](/relay/build/nips/).
  </Card>
  <Card title="Media apps" icon="document">
    A Blossom server is built in: upload, mirror, list, delete and range requests, on disk or S3.
    See [Blossom endpoints](/relay/build/blossom/).
  </Card>
  <Card title="Plugins" icon="puzzle">
    In-process TypeScript modules that filter writes, rewrite queries, hide events, check uploads, serve HTTP,
    run jobs and add pages to the admin panel. Start with [your first plugin](/relay/build/plugin-quickstart/).
  </Card>
  <Card title="Admin automation" icon="setting">
    Manage the relay from scripts with the [admin REST API](/relay/build/admin-api/) or from any
    [NIP-86](/relay/build/nip86/) management client.
  </Card>
</CardGrid>

## Which one do I need?

- **You're building a client.** You only need the relay and Blossom endpoints. Nothing here is beamhop-specific:
  standard libraries for Nostr and Blossom just work.
- **You want the relay to behave differently.** Write a [plugin](/relay/build/plugin-quickstart/). Hooks run inside
  the write and read pipelines, so you can enforce rules no client can get around.
- **You want to manage the relay from outside.** Use NIP-86 if a management client already speaks it, or the admin
  REST API for everything the panel can do.
- **You want to watch it.** Scrape [`/metrics` and the health probes](/relay/build/health-metrics/).
